description: tools/test-projects/terrain (WEB_PROJECT=terrain tools/build.sh web): a terrain displaced by a 16-bit heightmap (a 40 m Gaussian dome) in WebGL2, which has no 16-bit unorm textures: the heightmap reaches the vertex shader as R32F or R16F. The camera looks level at 5 m, so the canvas centre is the dome's lit flank (a neutral grey, no texture layers: 154 before the post-sync lighting, 204 after; the tolerance takes any lit grey and no sky) only when the heights are sampled; without them it is the sky (107 148 209) and sokol logs GL_TEXTURE_FORMAT_NOT_SUPPORTED every frame.
